news.title: No Lights, No Radio: Getting Oil Through Hormuz Is a Risky Job
news.summary: The tanker captain summoned his years of experience when he saw the blast in front of him. He veered his 300-meter-long ship around the vessel ahead and could see a fire had started. He called the US Navy to tell them of the attack.

news.title: Alaska LNG Could Cost More Than Double Gulf Coast Rivals, Raising Questions Over Economics
news.summary: US President Donald Trump's push to steer $54 billion of South Korean investment into Alaska LNG is putting a fresh focus on a 20 million-ton-a-year export project that would cost more than twice as much as a comparable US Gulf Coast plant.
